# Cleanzit India

> Laundry, dry cleaning, steam ironing and home deep-cleaning service based
> in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. Free pickup and delivery on orders above
> Rs 300, standard delivery within 3 days, 20% off the first order. Cleanzit
> is also a laundry franchise brand expanding across India — a pickup,
> clean-and-deliver model with training and support for franchise partners.

## Franchise

Cleanzit is expanding its laundry franchise across India. Total investment
starts from roughly Rs 8 lakhs for a Tier 3 city unit up to Rs 15-20 lakhs
for a Tier 1 metro flagship store, including equipment, interiors and
franchise fee. Typical ROI is 12-18 months with a 70-80% gross margin. No
prior laundry experience required — Cleanzit provides 15-day training.
Contact +91 77778 18188 or franchise@cleanzit.in.
